# Two vendor bills on a payable kept to a tenth of a cent, each overpaid.
#
# The bill-side twin of credit_on_an_account_kept_finer_than_the_cent.txt plus
# overpaid_invoice_on_a_finer_account.txt: the account's unit is finer than the
# currency's, so a settling split can be moved to a figure the currency cannot
# hold — which is what a book coming from the GnuCash GUI can carry and what a
# printed `payment:` block has to refuse rather than round.
#
# Two of them, because a run refused on its first bill cannot be told from
# a run that wrote nothing at all.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	commodity_scu: 1000
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	commodity_scu: 1000
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

vendor "V-FINE"
	name: "Fine Grained Supplies"
	currency: CAD

bill "BILL-FINE-ONE"
	vendor_id: "V-FINE"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "Paper"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 30
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-02-28
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
		memo: "BILL-FINE-ONE"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-05
		amount: 50.00
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Overpaid, to the thousandth"
		prepayment: 20.00

bill "BILL-FINE-TWO"
	vendor_id: "V-FINE"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-03-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-01
		description: "Ink"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 40
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-01
		due: 2026-03-31
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
		memo: "BILL-FINE-TWO"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-03-05
		amount: 55.00
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Overpaid, to the thousandth"
		prepayment: 15.00
